title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
abstract: arXiv:2611.25705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-ed

translated_title: STARK：迈向真正会学习与记忆的个性化智能体
translated_abstract: 长期记忆对于在长时间内与用户交互的个性化智能体系统至关重要，然而当前的架构只能捕获“发生了什么”，而将“为什么会发生”的推理留给底层大语言模型事后推导。这些事件不仅能够传达用户经历了什么，还能传达这些经历如何塑造了用户的行为模式。我们提出了STARK，一种双图记忆架构，它将这些事件不仅视为节点，还视为行为洞察之间的边。STARK维护一个情景图，将交互记录为在时间、因果和语义上相互关联的情景；以及一个洞察图，用于表示由大语言模型提取的行为信号，并根据支持这些信号的事件数量进行评分，同时通过引发这些洞察的事件将它们相互连接。在推理时，行为知识可以直接从由事件作为边所支撑的洞察节点中检索获得。
tldr: STARK提出了一种双图记忆架构，通过情景图记录用户交互事件、洞察图提取并连接行为模式，使个性化智能体能够真正学习和记住用户的行为规律。
en_tdlr: STARK is a dual-graph memory architecture that records user interactions in an Episodic Graph and connects LLM-extracted behavioral insights in an Insight Graph, enabling personalized agents that truly learn and remember user behavioral patterns.
